posts.title: Open Hardware is critially important in 2026
posts.description: It’s 2026, and Sam Altman thinks it’s a shame that you have RAM in your computer and not his data center. The leading 3d printer manufacturer by sales by default sends all the models you print to AWS. And your washing machine sends gigabytes of telemetry data to the manufacturer...
